tool_args.rationale: The supplied mechanism and signatures point to the two-layer siphon base plus an open local square-root branch. Five varied pilot rows support numerical identification of vmax, rho, and c_loc without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows span s_grad broadly and, per subtree guidance, already identify the three siphon parameters; an additional measurement is unnecessary.
The target horizon is short relative to tau and the indicated mechanism is a static reduced readout, so a trajectory batch adds little identifiability.
Its snapshot curve does not account for the verified sink-gradient dependence and open square-root branch.
It lacks the verified saturating siphon base and gradient-sink interaction.
